scoring_justification: Full recompute infeasible because agent outputs only final scalar results; checker independently compares agent's reported values to paper-derived gold with tolerances.

hidden_assets.purpose: gold values for e_T* and force constants C
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper Phys. Rev. B 47, 13861 (1993). e_T* for Li-P and Zn-P are explicitly stated as 1.56 and 1.84; force constants C are given as 4.44×10⁴ dyn/cm and 6.54×10⁴ dyn/cm (Ref. 21).
hidden_assets.generation_method: Values copied from the paper; numeric forms: 1.56, 1.84, 44400.0, 65400.0.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the paper's own reported numbers used as the reference for reproduction verification.

outputs.description: Macroscopic transverse effective charges (in units of elementary charge) and force constants (in dyn/cm) for Li-P and Zn-P bonds, computed from the given analytical relations and input constants.

output_contract.notes: All inputs are deterministic numeric constants provided in the task instruction. Unit conversions (cm/Å, g/u, cm⁻¹→rad/s, esu→e) are now explicitly given, making the target values reachable without guessing implicit conventions.
